comparison.objective: Pause both arms during a human stop signal, then resume and finish boxing cubes.
comparison.physical_skill: Visually triggered interruption and resumption of concurrent manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Combined gripper motion at most 3 cm while signal is raised, then all four cubes boxed; body gives no separate spec.
comparison.reason: The central ability is human-signal compliance, unrelated to precision mandrel use, impact fracture, insert preservation, or loose-part containment.
